RUN_2157A.notes: Standard sequencing run, all QC metrics nominal.

RUN_2156X.notes: Cross-contamination with E. coli control strain detected. Sequencing lanes mixed terrestrial and xenobiont material. All samples from this run must be excluded from xenobiont codon analysis.

RUN_2157Y.notes: Mass spectrometer calibration drift detected post-hoc. Protein identifications from this run are unreliable and should be discarded.

analysis_notes: Only use data from validated sequencing runs (qc_passed=true) for codon table reconstruction. The xenobiont uses a non-standard genetic code with context-dependent translation rules that modify amino acid output based on codon-boundary nucleotide context.
